body.x: Daeyoung Cheavi, a top positioned company in public marker for domestic electric vehicle charger, has presented electric car charger to target the American market in CES 2019 ‘Design & Source & MIK NIGHT’, the largest technology show in the world held in Las Vegas, USA from January 8 (Tue) to 11 (Fri).

Daeyoung Chaevi, a company that provides production and control of electric vehicle charger as well as one-step service solution, is on an upward trajectory for selling 6,000 chargers for an electric vehicle in 3 years since the first establishment of the company.

This company supports all different types of charging methods whether by country or manufacturing company, and it has various product series from slow charging type, fast charging type, charger type aimed for portability, and moving type of charger which moves according to the location of the electric car.
It is leading the market through operation service business by developing a combination of the loT-based control system and accounting system.

A certified reel type spring cable is applied to the charger to not drag on the floor, and the advantage of the charger is that it’s linked with its own management system eliminating additional payment for telecommunication fee.
The company has manufactured the product by using trendy wave design, and it has succeeded in patenting a technology in which a charger can power up several cars at the same time.

The credit card reader is installed in the product; it also has QR code, NFC, and other smart app payments. Through the use of loT technology, one can monitor the stationary state of the charger in real-time, and check the remaining battery and predicted charge completion through its own application.

In order to fit in the theme of the future intelligent vehicle, the company is doing its best for the development of future power distribution system which can conveniently manage specialized auto-battery system and infrastructure of the charger.

Minkyo Jung, the CEO of the company, said “Daeyoung Chaevi is currently on the project for supply of official charger with internationally known car manufacturing company and construction of fast charger. Since the project is progressing in other countries as well, we are looking for an excellent partner in this country to cooperate in the current project and other business opportunities through this CES." He added that “As this show being the debut of our product, we are hoping to advance into markets of USA, Mexico, Brazil, Australia, New Zealand, the Middle East countries, Vietnam, Thailand, Singapore, and European countries.”
